description: Short-lived access tokens pair with rotating refresh tokens; presenting a rotated (reused) refresh token revokes the entire token family and is audited.

requirements.description: Access tokens must be short-lived (configurable, default ≤15 min). Each sign-in issues a refresh token belonging to a token family. On refresh, the old refresh token is invalidated and a new one issued (rotation). If a previously rotated (already-used) refresh token is presented, the entire token family must be immediately revoked and the event audited. Revocation state is stored in Redis for hot-path lookups.
requirements.title: Refresh Token Rotation with Token-Family Reuse Detection and Revocation
